args: $d = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.mcp_servers\MCP_Web_Browser'; $g = Join-Path $d '.git'; if (!(Test-Path $g)) { if (Test-Path $d) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d }; git clone https://github.com/azzindani/MCP_Web_Browser.git $d --quiet } else { Set-Location $d; git fetch origin --quiet; git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD --quiet }; Set-Location $d; uv sync --quiet; uv run playwright install chromium --quiet; uv run python server.py
